text:
Priya (People Ops): FYI — manager asked for a single-page checklist we can hand to folks planning parental leave about hiring coverage, performance review timing, and benefits deadlines. put this together quickly?
Dan M: thanks. need it for an IC starting leave next month; we like to bring on a 3-month contractor to cover code review and pager.
Claire (Hiring): recruiting can spin up a contractor SOW, but we need the role summary + expected weekly hours and "must cover" tasks. also need a hiring budget line from the manager.
JP (Engineering Manager): OK. quick summary: 15hrs/week reviews, 2hrs/week on-call overlap for handover, own a small backlog of bugs. contractor doesn't need deploy access.
Priya (People Ops): great. two other things to flag: (1) performance review window 12: if the person has a scheduled mid-cycle review while on leave, they can opt to pause it until return or have a short manager-only calibration. (2) benefits enrollment deadlines: if they plan to change benefits while on leave, elections need to be filed before payroll processes the next cycle.
Dan M: for reviews, prefer to pause until return if they're taking >4 weeks. how do we formalize that so it's not forgotten?
Priya (People Ops): People Ops will log a "Review Pause" entry and notify compensation. Manager should email People Ops with: employee name, leave start/end, and "pause review" instruction. we'll track it and reopen in Workday on the return date.
Claire (Hiring): SOW template: i'll draft today. need these fields from the manager: role description, hourly rate cap, expected start/end, and tech stack.
JP (Engineering Manager): will post a short role blurb now: "Interim Code Reviewer — 3 months — JS/React + internal infra. 15hrs/wk. No deploy. On-call overlap: 2hrs/week for handover."
Priya (People Ops): checklist draft (paste into portal):
```
Parental Leave - Coverage & Admin Checklist
1) Manager: confirm coverage approach (contractor / redistribute / hiring) and budget.
2) Hiring: submit SOW or internal transfer request (include role blurb + hours).
3) People Ops: log leave, pause performance review? <yes/no>
4) Employee: submit benefits elections update before payroll cutoff (attach screenshot).
5) Payroll: confirm deductions continue? <People Ops confirm>
6) IT: adjust access for interim role (no deploy access unless approved).
7) Manager: set explicit handover hours & on-call overlap.
8) People Ops: schedule return-to-work check-in 2 weeks before end date.
```
Claire (Hiring): looks good. add a line about contractor NDAs and background checks — we handle that but it can add 3-5 business days.
Priya (People Ops): good call, added. also add a note about pro-rating equity vesting if leave > 30 days (link to policy).
Benefits Bot: Reminder: to change benefits while on leave, submit election change via Workday at least 10 business days before payroll cutoff: https://intranet.redwood/benefits/change
Dan M: timeline: employee starts leave 2025-05-12, want contractor start 2025-05-05 for 1-week overlap. is that possible?
Claire (Hiring): possible if SOW is signed by 2025-04-28 to hit vendor onboarding. manager please approve budget by COB 04-24.
JP (Engineering Manager): approving budget now. will DM the role blurb and post.
Priya (People Ops): will create the Review Pause entry and schedule the return check-in. sending checklist to the HR portal and cc'ing the manager. ping me if you want People Ops to pre-approve contractor SOW to speed vendor setup. :white_check_mark:
Dan M: thanks everyone, this is super helpful. i'll share the hire blurb + budget line in the SOW form today. :thumbsup:
